hashNote: Prompt hash metadata was added after holdout; the final hash is attached here retrospectively from the unchanged final template. Earlier prompt hash is not recorded.
labels: AI-authored; human review pending. Repeated family variants are dependent, not independent human ground truth.

timingMeaning.clock: Node performance.now; elapsed from the Playwright event for the first decision POST.
timingMeaning.httpHeadersMs: Until Playwright reports the HTTP response headers.
timingMeaning.httpResponseMs: Until the harness has received the complete decision response body.
timingMeaning.browserAcceptedMs: Until the harness observes the same snapshotId in the browser decision DOM. Includes Playwright IPC and polling delay; not an exact application callback timestamp.
timingMeaning.byteCounts: Actual UTF-8 snapshot POST body and decision response body bytes; excludes HTTP headers. Raw bodies are not retained.
